how_to_apply: Visit the official IIT Jodhpur R&D temporary project appointment portal.
Locate the relevant post from the list of current temporary position advertisements.
Review the project information, job description, and eligibility for that specific post.
Click the "Apply Now" button against the desired position.
Complete the online application form before the deadline of 13-08-2026, 11:55 PM.
Enclose the Caste Certificate along with the application if claiming category-based age relaxation.

All applications for this IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 cycle must be submitted online through the official IIT Jodhpur R&D outside project appointment portal. No other mode of application is mentioned in the provided notification.

Candidates who have completed their postgraduate degree in life sciences can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and M.Sc Life Sciences Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more research opportunities can also explore the latest [RajasthanGovernment Jobs across various departments. Those holding a postgraduate degree in science can also browse more M.Sc Government Jobs and Research Fellow Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.text: Eligibility differs by post since each project has separate qualification requirements set by the respective PI. Candidates should check the criteria for their specific post carefully before applying. Age is calculated as of the closing date of online application submission. Age relaxation is admissible for category candidates as per Central Government Rules, and applicants claiming relaxation must enclose their Caste Certificate along with the application. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Chemistry, selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship/Asst. Professorship) and GATE, or through national-level exams conducted by central government departments/agencies such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER

First class Master's Degree in any branch of Life Sciences, or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology/Medicine, with UGC-NET JRF/GATE qualification or equivalent national-level exam qualification (DBT, DST, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER)

M.A. in Psychology and Graduation in Psychology with at least 55% marks in both degrees from a recognized University/Institute, plus a minimum of 1 year of relevant counselling experience (preferably in an educational/clinical/counselling setup); good oral/written communication skills; proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint or equivalent
B.Tech. with GATE qualification, or B.Tech. with 60% marks or equivalent, in Mechanical Engineering/Aerospace Engineering or equivalent

Ph.D. in Synthetic Organic Chemistry with First Class or equivalent, along with a good academic record; minimum two refereed publications as first or corresponding author in SCI journals of international repute
Four-year Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology or equivalent, OR Master's Degree (MTech/MS) in Engineering/Technology or equivalent, OR MCA/MSc in Computer Science/IT/AI/DS or equivalent

faq.question: Q1. What is IITJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IITJ) to fill six temporary project staff positions — Junior Research Fellow (2 posts), Post-Doctoral Research Fellow, Project Assistant, Project Associate-I, and Junior Counselor — under various sponsored research projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies in total, with 1 vacancy for each of the six posts advertised.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for all six posts is 13-08-2026, up to 11:55 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ by post, ranging from a Bachelor's/Master's degree with NET/GATE or equivalent national-level exam qualification, to a Ph.D. with published research for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post. See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age limits range from 27 to 40 years depending on the post. See the age limit table above.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the official IITJ R&D temporary project appointment portal by clicking "Apply Now" against the relevant post before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated compensation ranges from Rs. 30,000–37,000 (plus HRA in one case) up to Rs. 65,000 depending on the post. See the salary table above for exact figures.
